A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:

* Component B: volume 39 cubic meters

* Component D: volume 34 cubic meters

* Component Y: volume 57 cubic meters
* Component Z: volume 67 cubic meters

* Component \: volume 65 cubic meters
* Component ]: volume 45 cubic meters
* Component ^: volume 36 cubic meters
* Component _: volume 35 cubic meters
* Component `: volume 51 cubic meters
* Component a: volume 56 cubic meters
* Component b: volume 64 cubic meters
* Component c: volume 49 cubic meters
* Component d: volume 43 cubic meters
* Component e: volume 61 cubic meters

Each cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic meters. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes possible. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume in any plane cannot exceed its capacity limit.
